summary: Embraer S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing the minutes of its Annual General Shareholders Meeting held April 29, 2026. The meeting covered routine items: approval of fiscal year 2025 financial statements, dividend allocation, election of a Fiscal Council and a Board member nominated by the Golden Share holder, and determination of management and Fiscal Council compensation. No special-situation events—such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring—were disclosed. The filing is a routine report of a foreign private issuer's annual meeting.
